name: SoulPeg USD
oneLiner: spUSD is SoulPeg's BNB Chain sUSDC wrapper: unwrap returns the receipt; USDC redemption requires protocol owner or operator action.
collateral: SoulPeg sUSDC receipts held by the BNB Chain SPUSD wrapper. SoulPeg describes a USDC-funded Venus strategy architecture, but the complete current underlying strategy allocation and receipt-to-USDC liquidity are not established; ordinary unwrap returns sUSDC, not USDC.
pegMechanism: SPUSD is a 1:1 transferable wrapper around SoulPeg sUSDC. The verified wrapper burns unlocked SPUSD and returns an equal amount of sUSDC in one transaction without a protocol conversion fee. The separate sUSDC-to-USDC earlyRedeem call is owner/operator-controlled and reserve-dependent; no holder-exercisable USDC completion guarantee or same-notional exit capacity is established.

notices.title: Unwrap returns sUSDC, not USDC
notices.message: SoulPeg's documented and source-reviewed unwrap path returns the sUSDC receipt. USDC redemption requires protocol owner or operator action and available reserves. Receipt valuation and executable exit capacity remain unresolved.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: spUSD is a transferable wrapper over a USDC-funded lending position and retains a 1:1 reserve-receipt mechanism.
